description: Project N.O.M.A.D. — an offline knowledge and education server: Wikipedia and other libraries, courses, books and tools, on hardware you own.

ports.description: Information Library (Kiwix, 8090), Data Tools (8100). Ranges, not single ports: an app's port opens only when it is installed in the Command Center, so the readiness wait must not wait for it
Notes (8200), Education Platform (Kolibri, 8310-8311), Supply Depot apps (8400-8500)

ingress.description: Client networks reach the Command Center and the apps it links to, at nomad.dmz.internal; nothing is published outside the site
